gloss: to be see-through; to be transparent

definitions.gloss: to be transparent; to be see-through
definitions.explanation: Describes when something can be seen through another material, or when underlying things become visible.

definitions.gloss: to show through; to be visible
definitions.explanation: When something beneath or behind becomes visible through a surface or covering.

⟦カーテン→カーテン：01342_kaaten⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{薄|うす}くて→薄い：00764_usui⟧⟦{外|そと}→外：00671_soto⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{透|す}けて⟦{見|み}える→見える：01165_mieru⟧。
examples.english: The curtains are thin and you can see outside through them.

notes:
{透|す}ける is an intransitive verb (⟦{自動詞|じどうし}→自動詞：10977_jidoushi⟧) describing when something is transparent or see-through. There is no direct transitive pair.

ASPECT (ている):
{透|す}けて⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧ indicates an ongoing state of being see-through or transparent.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- ⟦{光|ひかり}→光：01707_hikari⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{透|す}ける - light shows through
- ⟦{肌|はだ}→肌：02243_hada⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{透|す}ける - skin is translucent
- {透|す}けて⟦{見|み}える→見える：01165_mieru⟧ - to be visible through (something)

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{透明|とうめい}→透明：04565_toumei⟧ - transparent (adjective)
- ⟦{透|す}かす→透かす：14426_sukasu⟧ - to look through, to hold up to light (transitive)
